title.zh: 证书仓库调用额度查询

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second for each user. If you exceed the limit, your API calls are throttled. This may impact your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.
